brief: Calculate move-in costs separately from recurring housing costs.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Moving Costs"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Dinero necesario para mudarte"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Dinheiro necessário para mudar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Calculate move-in costs separately from recurring housing costs.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Moving can require cash before the usual monthly payments begin; use fictional dollars to separate both needs.
instruction.misconception: The monthly rent alone equals all cash needed to move in, or a refundable deposit is already available to spend.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Rent repeats monthly; a deposit and moving charge are needed upfront here. A refundable deposit still requires cash now.
The move-in total includes rent, deposit and moving charge.
Only the rent is stated as recurring monthly.
All three upfront requirements need funding.
A possible later refund does not fund today’s required deposit.
Moving in does not remove later recurring payments.
Prepayment, deposit and connection all require money at entry.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Moving can require cash before the usual monthly payments begin; use fictional dollars to separate both needs.

es-MX.line: Mudarte puede requerir efectivo antes de los pagos mensuales habituales; separa ambas necesidades con pesos ficticios.

pt-BR.line: Mudar pode exigir dinheiro antes dos pagamentos mensais comuns; separe ambas as necessidades com reais fictícios.

en-US.line: Rent repeats monthly; a deposit and moving charge are needed upfront here. A refundable deposit still requires cash now.

es-MX.line: Aquí la renta se repite mensualmente; depósito y mudanza se pagan al entrar. Un depósito reembolsable aún requiere efectivo ahora.

pt-BR.line: Aqui o aluguel se repete mensalmente; depósito e mudança são pagos ao entrar. Um depósito reembolsável ainda exige dinheiro agora.

en-US.prompt: Move-in cash: first rent 1000 dollars, deposit 1000, moving charge 200. Add all required upfront amounts.

feedback.met: The move-in total includes rent, deposit and moving charge.
feedback.not_yet: Count every upfront requirement, even a refundable deposit.

help: Count every upfront requirement, even a refundable deposit.

es-MX.prompt: Efectivo de entrada: primera renta 1000 pesos, depósito 1000, mudanza 200. Suma todos los montos iniciales requeridos.

feedback.met: El total inicial incluye renta, depósito y mudanza.
feedback.not_yet: Cuenta todo requisito inicial, incluso depósito reembolsable.

help: Cuenta todo requisito inicial, incluso depósito reembolsable.

pt-BR.prompt: Dinheiro de entrada: primeiro aluguel 1000 reais, depósito 1000, mudança 200. Some todos os valores iniciais exigidos.

feedback.met: O total inicial inclui aluguel, depósito e mudança.
feedback.not_yet: Conte todo requisito inicial, mesmo depósito reembolsável.

help: Conte todo requisito inicial, mesmo depósito reembolsável.

feedback.met: Only the rent is stated as recurring monthly.
feedback.not_yet: Use the frequency given for each payment.

feedback.met: Solo la renta se indica como recurrente mensual.
feedback.not_yet: Usa la frecuencia dada de cada pago.

feedback.met: Só o aluguel é dado como recorrente mensal.
feedback.not_yet: Use a frequência dada de cada pagamento.

es-MX.scene: Primera renta 800; depósito 800; mudanza 150. Todo se exige antes de entrar.
